key_components.name: Live Camera Ingestion Viewfinder & Facial HUD
features: EXECUTE IMAGE SCAN button triggers 2.5s emerald neon laser overlay pulse and video freeze frame simulation
Real-time Facial Geometry Landmark HUD overlay (Face shape: Oval/Square/Heart/Round, Undertone temperature, Jawline angularity, Symmetry ratio)
Skin (3), Body (3), Hair (4), Face (4) interactive neural profile modifier sliders and selectors

key_components.name: Procedural 144+ Outfit Matrix Engine
features: 36 base profiles scaled to 144+ procedural look payload variations
Cultural & Category Switcher: Indian (Kurta, Sherwani, Lehenga, Saree, Indo-Western Fusion) & Western (Streetwear, Luxury, Smart Casual, Tailored Evening)
Gender catalog toggle: Male vs Female separate catalog views with tailored metrics
5-Piece itemized breakdowns: Top, Bottom, Footwear drop, Eyewear, Wristwear with curated high-res imagery & color theory palettes
Interactive accessory & grooming engine with dynamic tailored recommendations based on detected face shape

key_components.name: Asynchronous Telemetry Stream Terminal
features: Real-time asynchronous line-by-line typing effect tracing logs
Triggers automatically on camera scan or profile modifier change
Status logs: Hardware verification, Matrix index vector compilation, Vector Knowledge Base search, Structural constraint filters, Output compliance push

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure App.jsx implements native HTML5 navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia webcam video streaming, 2.5s scan laser overlay, 144+ procedural look lookup matrix engine, male and female catalog distinction, Indian and Western categories, dynamic face landmark HUD detection overlay, line-by-line asynchronous typing terminal logs, and data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow APCA contrast rules, ensure responsive mobile-first layouts, attach data-testid attributes to buttons, selects, and cards, and strictly use dark emerald obsidian glassmorphism aesthetics with drop-shadow aura filters.
